name: D-allothreonine to L-methionine
summary: A 7-step route from D-allothreonine zwitterion to L-methionine, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: aldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP(+))
reactions.equation: acetaldehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = acetate + NADPH + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (uracil(1939)-C(5))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(1939) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methyluridine(1939) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (cytosine(1962)-C(5))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(1962) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-methylcytidine(1962) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (uracil(1498)-N(3))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(1498) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(3)-methyluridine(1498) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (cytidine(1402)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(1402) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(1402) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)
